text: _The rays of the fun are not all equally refrangible: and thief rays, which have a different degree of re-fragibility, here likewise a different colors._

parsed.faithful: The rays of the fun are not all equally refrangible: and thofe rays, which have a different degree of re-frangibility, have likewife a different colour.
parsed.modern: The rays of the fun are not all equally refrangible: and those rays, which have a different degree of refrangibility, have likewise a different colour.
